- **“The Last Voyage of the Queen”** has become a streaming juggernaut, appearing on every major platform from Disney+ to Peacock. It’s a historical drama that blends real events with fictional characters, and it’s been praised for its lush cinematography and strong ensemble cast.

- **“Avatar 3”** continues James Cameron’s exploration of Pandora, bringing new species and deeper environmental themes. It’s a visual spectacle that’s drawing fans of the original film and newcomers alike.

- **“Oppenheimer”** remains a critical darling, with Nolan’s signature storytelling and a stellar cast. It’s a must-watch for history buffs and film enthusiasts.

- **“The Marvels”** is part of Disney’s push to keep the MCU alive on streaming, offering a fresh take on cosmic adventures while staying true to the franchise’s core.
